baseline_prompt_en: Create a complex photorealistic full-body editorial photograph of one unmistakably adult woman cyclist at a fogbound ferry bicycle checkpoint, using the supplied portrait only as a facial, hair, and general-appearance reference. She stands on the wet salt-sprayed vehicle deck beside a road bicycle, one hand holding the handlebar while the other presents a paper ferry ticket toward a small illuminated scanner; the lowered barrier, wheel channel, deck arrows, and distant ferry wake make the cycling checkpoint unmistakable. Amber deck lamps shine through maritime fog and bead across steel, cables, and realistic skin texture. Her fitted technical cycling wardrobe is present, while its garment topology is intentionally unspecified in this authorial core. Frame her head-to-shoes in a stable three-quarter stance with the bicycle offset behind her and ferry rails outside her silhouette. Visual priority: shoulders/upper torso, waist, crotch, both thighs/short hems, and cycling context must remain inspectable in the same frame. Preserve realistic anatomy, natural fabric tension, salt mist, restrained color, and documentary depth.
